n an electronic receiver that detects and demodulates and amplifies transmitted signals
n a communication system based on broadcasting electromagnetic waves
v transmit messages via radio waves
radios.translation: n. 收音机；无线电话；无线电广播设备（radio的复数）

radioscope.translation:
n. 放射镜, 剂量测定验电器
[医] 放射镜, X线透视屏, 放射探测仪

radioscopic.translation: a. 放射镜的, 放射观察法的

radioscopy.definition: n. (radiology) examination of the inner structure of opaque objects using X rays or other penetrating radiation
radioscopy.translation:
n. 射线透视, X光透视
[化] 射线探伤; 放射线探伤

radiosensitive.translation:
a. 放射敏感的
[医] 放射敏感的

radiosensitivity.definition: n sensitivity to the action of radiant energy
radiosensitivity.translation:
n. 放射敏感度
[化] 辐射敏感性

radioshielding.translation: 射频屏蔽, 高频屏蔽

radiosonde.translation:
n. 无线电高空测候器, 无线电探空仪
[电] 无线电测候仪

radiosonde commutator.translation: [电] 无线电探空仪转换开关

radiosonde recorder.translation: [电] 无线电测候仪记录器

radiosonde transmitter.translation: [电] 无线电测候仪发射机

radiospectroscopy.translation: 放射光谱学, 无线电频谱学, 电磁能全景接收技术

radiostat.translation: 中放晶体滤波式超外差接收机

radiosterilize.translation: vt.用辐射给…灭菌,用辐射给…消毒

radiosterrilize.translation: 对...辐射灭菌, 用放射线对...消毒

radiosulfur.translation:
[化] 射硫; 硫35
[医] 放射性硫, 射硫

radiosymmetrical.translation: a. [数]径向对称的, [动]辐射对称的

radiotechnology.translation: n. 辐射能,(X光)在工业上的运用

radiotelecontrol.translation: 无线电遥控 , 无线电远距离控 制

radiotelegraph.definition:
n. telegraphy that uses transmission by radio rather than by wire
n. the use of radio to send telegraphic messages (usually by Morse code)
radiotelegraph.translation: n. 无线电报机, 无线电报术

radiotelegraphic.translation: a. 无线电报的, 用无线电报的

radiotelegraphy.definition:
n telegraphy that uses transmission by radio rather than by wire
n the use of radio to send telegraphic messages (usually by Morse code)

radiotelephone.definition:
n. telephony that uses transmission by radio rather than by wire
n. a telephone that communicates by radio waves rather than along cables
radiotelephone.translation:
n. 无线电话学
v. 打无线电话

radiotelephonic.definition: a relating to or by means of radiotelephony

radiotelephony.definition: n telephony that uses transmission by radio rather than by wire
radiotelephony.translation:
n. 无线电话学
[电] 无线电话

radiotelescopes.translation: (radiotelescope 的复数) n. 射电望远镜

radioteletype.translation: n. 无线电传打字机, 无线电传打字电报机网络

radioteletypewriter.translation: n. 无线电电传打字电报机, 无线电电传打字电报设备

radiothanatology.translation: [医] 放射死因学(研究放射能对死组织的效应)

radiotherapeutic.translation: 放射疗法的, 放射治疗的, 与放疗有关的

radiotherapist.definition: n a medical specialist who uses radioactive substances and X-rays in the treatment of disease
radiotherapist.translation:
n. 放射治疗学家
[医] 放射治疗学家

radiotherapists.definition: n. a medical specialist who uses radioactive substances and X-rays in the treatment of disease

radiotherapy.definition: n. (medicine) the treatment of disease (especially cancer) by exposure to a radioactive substance
radiotherapy.translation:
n. 放射疗法
[医] 放射疗法, 放射治疗

radiothermy.translation:
n. 短波透热, 热放射疗
[医] 热放射疗法, 短波透热法

radiothorium.definition: n radioactive isotope of thorium with mass number 228

radiotomy.translation: [医] 体层X线照相术, 断层X线照相术

radiotoxologic.translation: a. 研究辐射毒物学的

radiotransparent.translation: a. 在X光照射中不显影的

radiotreatment.translation: 放射处理, 辐射处理

radiotron.translation: 真空管, 三极电子管

radiotropism.translation: [医] 向放射性, 向辐射性

radiovision.translation:
n. (无线)电视
[电] 无线电视

radiowind.translation: 无线电测风仪; 测风雷达
